items.source: NOTE: Exception handling in TaskDecorator implementations is limited to plain Runnable execution via execute calls. In case of #submit calls, the exposed Runnable will be a FutureTask which does not propagate any exceptions; you might have to cast it and call Future#get to evaluate exceptions. See the ThreadPoolExecutor#afterExecute javadoc for an example of how to access exceptions in such a Future case.
items.translation: 注意：TaskDecorator 实现中的异常处理仅限于通过 execute 调用执行的普通 Runnable。对于 #submit 调用，暴露的 Runnable 将是一个 FutureTask，它不会传播任何异常；您可能需要将其转换为 Future 并调用 Future#get 来评估异常。有关如何在此类 Future 情况下访问异常的示例，请参阅 ThreadPoolExecutor#afterExecute 的 Javadoc。

items.source: NOTE: This class implements Spring's TaskExecutor interface as well as the Executor interface, with the former being the primary interface, the other just serving as secondary convenience. For this reason, the exception handling follows the TaskExecutor contract rather than the Executor contract, in particular regarding the TaskRejectedException.
items.translation: 注意：该类实现了 Spring 的TaskExecutor接口以及Executor接口，其中前者为主要接口，后者仅作为辅助便利。因此，异常处理遵循 TaskExecutor 契约而非 Executor 契约，特别是关于TaskRejectedException的部分。

items.source: For an alternative, you may set up a ThreadPoolExecutor instance directly using constructor injection, or use a factory method definition that points to the Executors class. To expose such a raw Executor as a Spring TaskExecutor, simply wrap it with a ConcurrentTaskExecutor adapter.
items.translation: 作为替代方案，您可以使用构造函数注入直接设置 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 实例，或者使用指向 Executors 类的工厂方法定义。要将此类原始 `Executor` 暴露为 Spring TaskExecutor，只需将其包装在 ConcurrentTaskExecutor 适配器中。

items.source: Switch this to "true" for a strict early shutdown signal analogous to the 6.1-established default behavior of ThreadPoolTaskScheduler. Note that the related flags ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setAcceptTasksAfterContextClose(boolean) and ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setWaitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown(boolean) will override this setting, leading to a late shutdown without a coordinated lifecycle stop phase.
items.translation: 将此项切换为 "true"，以发出严格的早期关闭信号，类似于 ThreadPoolTaskScheduler 在 6.1 版本中建立的默认行为。请注意，相关的标志 ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setAcceptTasksAfterContextClose(boolean) 和 ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setWaitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown(boolean) 将覆盖此设置，导致在没有协调的生命周期停止阶段的情况下进行延迟关闭。

items.source: By default, existing tasks will be allowed to complete within the coordinated lifecycle stop phase in any case. This setting just controls whether an explicit ThreadPoolExecutor.shutdown() call will be triggered on context close, rejecting task submissions after that point.
items.translation: 默认情况下，现有任务将在协调的生命周期停止阶段内被允许完成。此设置仅控制是否在上下文关闭时触发显式的 ThreadPoolExecutor.shutdown() 调用，从而在该点之后拒绝任务提交。

items.source: As of 6.1.4, the default is "false", leniently allowing for late tasks to arrive after context close, still participating in the lifecycle stop phase. Note that this differs from ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setAcceptTasksAfterContextClose(boolean) which completely bypasses the coordinated lifecycle stop phase, with no explicit waiting for the completion of existing tasks at all.
items.translation: 自 6.1.4 版本起，默认值为 "false"，宽容地允许任务在上下文关闭后到达，但仍参与生命周期停止阶段。请注意，这与 ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setAcceptTasksAfterContextClose(boolean) 不同，后者完全绕过协调的生命周期停止阶段，根本不对现有任务的完成进行显式等待。

items.source: As of 6.1, this method comes with a default implementation that delegates to TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable).
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，此方法具有默认实现，该实现委托给 TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable)。

items.source: The default configuration is a core pool size of 1, with unlimited max pool size and unlimited queue capacity. This is roughly equivalent to Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(), sharing a single thread for all tasks. Setting "queueCapacity" to 0 mimics Executors.newCachedThreadPool(), with immediate scaling of threads in the pool to a potentially very high number. Consider also setting a "maxPoolSize" at that point, as well as possibly a higher "corePoolSize" (see also the "allowCoreThreadTimeOut" mode of scaling).
items.translation: 默认配置的核心线程池大小为 1，最大线程池大小和队列容量均为无限。这大致相当于 Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()，即所有任务共享单个线程。将 "queueCapacity" 设置为 0 可模拟 Executors.newCachedThreadPool()，线程池中的线程会立即扩展至可能非常高的数量。在此情况下，还应考虑设置 "maxPoolSize"，以及可能需要更高的 "corePoolSize"（另请参阅 "allowCoreThreadTimeOut" 扩展模式）。
